name: Treegia
source:
Origin: Realm Phantasma 
Hobby: Striking poses
Job: Prince

Idiotic, melodramatic, narcissistic. He loves you, but he loves himself the most. He can turn any negative comments into positive comments. He is actually the prince of Treegia Kingdom. He refers himself as Mr. Somebody, Mr. Nobody and Mr. Anybody.
